summary: Read a list of positive integers that may repeat, then read one target total. Find every selection whose values add up to that total. Inside one selection, each position of the list may be taken at most once, so equal values still belong to separate positions. When two selections contain the same values the same number of times, keep a single copy. Write every selection that remains after those copies are dropped.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
